tools.name: oxygen_list_contacts
tools.description: List customers and suppliers, with optional filters by VAT number, email or code. Oxygen API: GET /contacts.

tools.name: oxygen_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id, with name, VAT number, tax office and address. Oxygen API: GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: oxygen_list_invoices
tools.description: List issued invoices, with optional filters by contact, date range or invoice number. Oxygen API: GET /invoices.

tools.name: oxygen_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id, with its line items, totals and MyData status. Oxygen API: GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: oxygen_list_products
tools.description: List products and services, with optional filters by name or code. Oxygen API: GET /products.

tools.name: oxygen_get_product
tools.description: Get one product or service by id, with its net sale price and VAT rate. Oxygen API: GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: oxygen_list_credit_notes
tools.description: List issued credit notes, with optional filters by contact or date range. Oxygen API: GET /credit-notes.

tools.name: oxygen_list_notices
tools.description: List quotes and proforma notices (Oxygen 'notices'), with optional filters by contact or date range. Oxygen API: GET /notices.

tools.name: oxygen_list_taxes
tools.description: List the VAT rates (tax ids) the company uses. Pass one as tax_id on an invoice line, or as sale_tax_id when you create a product. Oxygen API: GET /taxes.

tools.name: oxygen_list_payment_methods
tools.description: List the payment methods the company uses. Pass one as payment_method_id when you create an invoice. Oxygen API: GET /payment-methods.

tools.name: oxygen_list_numbering_sequences
tools.description: List the numbering sequences (document series). Pass one as numbering_sequence_id when you create an invoice. Oxygen API: GET /numbering-sequences.

tools.name: oxygen_create_contact
tools.description: Create a customer or supplier. Creates a new record in the company's Oxygen account. Oxygen API: POST /contacts.

tools.name: oxygen_create_product
tools.description: Create a product or service in the company's catalogue, with a net sale price and VAT rate (see oxygen_list_taxes). Oxygen API: POST /products.

tools.name: oxygen_create_invoice
tools.description: WARNING: creates a real invoice in Oxygen Pelatologio and sends it to MyData (AADE). It uses a number from the numbering sequence and cannot be undone by this tool. Confirm the customer, items and amounts first. Oxygen API: POST /invoices.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "oxygen_list_contacts" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "oxygen_list_products" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: oxygen_list_contacts · Private data: oxygen_list_contacts, oxygen_get_contact, oxygen_list_invoices, oxygen_list_credit_notes, oxygen_list_notices, oxygen_list_numbering_sequences, oxygen_create_contact · Public sink: oxygen_list_contacts, oxygen_create_contact, oxygen_create_product, oxygen_create_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: oxygen_list_contacts · Private data: oxygen_list_contacts, oxygen_get_contact, oxygen_list_invoices, oxygen_list_credit_notes, oxygen_list_notices, oxygen_list_numbering_sequences, oxygen_create_contact · Public sink: oxygen_list_contacts, oxygen_create_contact, oxygen_create_product, oxygen_create_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
